Answer: D
Reason: Figure 1 demonstrates extensive consolidation in the left lung, while Figure 2 shows resolution of the left-sided opacity with new consolidation appearing in the right upper lobe. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one location accompanied by new infiltrates in another is the classic migratory nature characteristic of cryptogenic organizing pneumonia (COP).
